what: BN4's panel changer and its Hole panel located and read (bn4_panels.h BN4_PANEL_CHANGER 0x080E4354, BN4_PANEL_CHANGER_KINDS 0x080E423C, BN4_PANEL_HOLE 0x0B and its six readers, BN4_PANEL_STEP 0x08009740, BN4_PANEL_BLINK_SET 0x08009E38; docs/rom/bn4.md). The Hole panel is what a DS Navi chip's power counts (BN4_DS_POWER 0x08019518, BN4_DS_POWERS 0x08018B48, BN4_PANEL_COUNT 0x08009F40). BN4's dark chips' price is in code (xreg4_dark_ids, the hook's test); the dark units derived, none moved yet.
